input_signals.name: array_done_i
input_signals.description: Array completion for the issued tile command.

input_signals.name: array_error_i
input_signals.description: Array error for the issued tile command.

output_signals.name: done_o
output_signals.description: All full-checkpoint tile commands have been issued.

output_signals.name: op_index_o
output_signals.description: Current linear op index within the layer.

cycles.responsibility: Select the next TinyLlama linear tile command.
cycles.dpi_check: DPI records the phase and later checks issued_commands_o.

cycles.responsibility: Present cmd_valid_o and hold the payload stable.
Accept the command when cmd_ready_i is high.
Wait for the first array progress beat.
Wait for the second array progress beat.
Wait for the third array progress beat.
Sample array_done_i or array_error_i for the command.
cycles.dpi_check: DPI drives array_done_i in this phase.

cycles.responsibility: Advance layer/op/tile counters for the next command.
cycles.dpi_check: DPI checks the accepted command count.

input_signals.name: stream_valid_i
input_signals.description: External input stream valid into the latch buffer.

input_signals.name: stream_data_i
input_signals.description: External input stream data into the latch buffer.

output_signals.name: stream_ready_o
output_signals.description: Latch buffer can accept stream data.

output_signals.name: array_cmd_valid_o
output_signals.description: Gated command-valid signal sent to the array.

output_signals.name: buffer_array_valid_o
output_signals.description: Latch-buffer output valid toward the array.

output_signals.name: buffer_array_ready_o
output_signals.description: Array input-ready signal toward the latch buffer.

output_signals.name: buffer_array_data_o
output_signals.description: Latched stream data toward the array.

cycles.responsibility: Start the scheduler/latch/array composition.
cycles.dpi_check: DPI records the composed engine phase.

cycles.responsibility: Expose the ungated scheduler command-valid.
cycles.dpi_check: DPI records valid before array valid.

cycles.responsibility: Gate the command into the systolic array.
Present the first latched stream beat to the array.
Stage or forward the next stream beat.
Continue array input transfer.
Observe the systolic-array completion pulse.
Return the composition to ready for the next tile.

output_signals.name: done_o

output_signals.description: Original ordered graph slot for the control op.

cycles.responsibility: Present the current non-linear control op.
Read source/control metadata for the op.
Execute the CPU/control operation.
Commit the op and advance counters.

cycles.responsibility: Present the ordered TinyLlama layer graph slot.
Launch either the control or linear slot engine.
Wait for the selected slot engine to complete.
cycles.dpi_check: DPI drives op_done_i in this phase.

cycles.responsibility: Commit the graph slot and advance layer/slot counters.

Finish the slot or advance to its next tile.
